## Summary

Describe the need, requested outcome, and contribution class.

## Framework Effect

Identify the affected canonical documents, decisions, examples, governance, or
project records. Explain whether business meaning or authority changes.

## Evidence and Provenance

List relevant sources, rights, assistance, assumptions, limitations, and domain
review. Separate framework requirements from domain-specific or implementation
choices.

## Publication Safety

Confirm that private, confidential, credential, unsafe, security-sensitive, and
improperly licensed information has been removed.

## Verification

List the checks performed for links, terminology, examples, diagrams, and any
other affected material. Run `scripts/validate-repository.sh` before requesting
review.

## Checklist

- [ ] I followed `CONTRIBUTING.md` and any applicable specialized contribution
      SOP.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under the MIT License.
- [ ] I disclosed material limitations and unresolved questions.
- [ ] I updated affected navigation, status, decisions, and change history.
- [ ] `scripts/validate-repository.sh` passes, or I explained why a check could
      not run.
- [ ] I did not imply domain validation, organizational approval, or authority
      that did not occur.
